metadata.explanation: This plan implements a de novo design workflow for a GB1-like domain. It starts with sequence generation (ProtGPT2) respecting length and secondary structure constraints. It then uses OpenFold (per override) for structure prediction. Following the 'design-predict-redesign' paradigm (Rule 10), ProteinMPNN refines the sequence on the predicted backbone, and OpenFold re-predicts the structure. Subsequent steps validate secondary structure (DSSP), quality/solubility (BiopythonQC), and stability (MDA). MMseqs2 checks for novelty. Finally, the Objective Ranker aggregates metrics to select the best candidate. Local tools are prioritized as per constraints.
